export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'toyo-engineering-india-private-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/toyo-engineering-india-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 486 Records detected' but every row shown is an INBOUND record with Toyo as BUYER, e.g. '2026-02-23 | SUNGKWANG BEND CO., LTD | TOYO ENGINEERING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ... | BusanKorea | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 73072300 | 7695293' and '2026-01-31 | GANSU NABOWANG CHEMICAL PRODUCTS CO., LTD | TOYO ENGINEERING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | DIMETHYL DISULPHIDE (DMDS) | Tianjin, CHINA | MUNDRA SEA, India | 29309099 | 7242077'. No outbound shipment row, no export destination, no export B/L was visible in the free view. Counter check: page claims 486 shipments; rows actually rendered = 5 (all imports). Slug variants 'toyo-engineering-india-ltd' and 'toyo-engineering-india' returned zero rendered records ('Loading...' / empty tables). Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/toyo-engineering-india/export/), Eximpedia and Trademo free views returned HTTP 403, so no export-side dataset could be read. Declared HS 840681 / 847989 (turbines, machinery) does not appear in any observed record; observed HS codes are 73072300, 29309099, 32141000, 85234930, 39269099 — all procurement inputs for EPC projects, not export goods.
domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.toyo-eng.com/in/en/company/) states: 'Toyo Engineering India Private Limited (Toyo-India), an Engineering Consultancy & Contracting Company, is a perfect blend of Japanese technology and management practices with Indian expertise and ingenuity.' and 'Over 10,000 employees ; 14 Group Companies ; Offices in 17 countries'. The site lists project sectors (https://www.toyo-eng.com/in/en/experience/projects/): 'Oil & Gas Processing, Refineries Petrochemicals Fertilisers Cryogenics Power Water Industrial' — but no named client, contract value, GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split was retrievable: the 'Our Clients' page returned 'The page does not exist', and TheCompanyCheck (403) and Trademo (403) blocked access. GST turnover: null (not public in sources reachable). No tender/contract record with a date and buyer was seen.
note: EPC engineering contractor (Toyo Engineering group, Japan), Mumbai HQ at Toyo House, Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg, Kanjurmarg West. Verified activity is on the BUYING side only: 5 dated import B/Ls (2025-12-20 to 2026-02-23) from Korea, China, Japan, Austria for project materials (elbows, DMDS, mastic, sealing rings, drawings). No export shipment record found in any accessible source, and no domestic supply record (tender/contract/GST band) could be confirmed — the site's project-sector list is a claim, not evidence. Per Rule 5: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено; внутренние поставки — заявлено, не подтверждено. Note the declared HS 840681/847989 is inconsistent with observed trade (company imports fabricated piping/chemicals, does not appear to export turbines); per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with HS corrected to actual observed codes (73072300, 29309099, 32141000, 85234930, 39269099) and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: neither manufacturer nor trader of goods — EPC contractor / project engineering services; recommend classifying as 'unknown' or service-provider rather than manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in reachable sources).
